verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same layout. Both have the same problems: a leftover empty translucent grey bar across the top that does nothing, a ragged headline break ('MODERN' alone on its line, then a much longer 'FURNITURE DESIGN'), and two info boxes whose tops and heights don't match. A's headline and boxes sit tight to the canvas edges (about 30px), so it feels slightly cramped. B uses wider margins (about 46px) on both sides, with the headline, grey bar and boxes on a shared left edge, so it's marginally cleaner.
